sam (new hire): Hey team — trying to run the repo's postgres via docker-compose on my Mac (Apple Silicon). Using a bind mount to ./pgdata and initdb fails with permission denied. Any quick fixes?

anya (eng): Welcome! Can you paste the error and compose snippet?

sam (new hire): Error: 
```
FATAL: could not open directory "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal": Permission denied
initdb: could not create directory "/var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal": Permission denied
```
compose: 
```
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
    volumes:
      - ./pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
```

sam (new hire): I tried `sudo chown -R 999:999 ./pgdata` but still same.

luis (devex): On Docker Desktop the bind mount goes through the macOS VM. chown on host usually works but APFS + Apple Silicon can behave oddly.

anya (eng): Options: 1) Use a named volume: `volumes:
  - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data` and add `volumes:
  pgdata:` at bottom. 2) Set `PGDATA` to a subdir so the container creates it (correct ownership). 3) One-off `docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/pgdata:/target alpine chown -R 999:999 /target` (may still fail on Docker Desktop).

sam (new hire): Will named volume break needing to inspect SQL files?

luis (devex): Named volume lives in Docker; you can `docker run --rm -v pgdata:/mnt busybox ls -la /mnt` or `docker cp`. For init scripts, mount `./docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro` and keep data in named volume.

anya (eng): Also ensure the image supports arm64. Check with `docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 postgres:15 uname -m`. Using x86-only images via emulation can cause weird perms.

sam (new hire): Switched to named volume and `docker compose down -v` then `docker compose up`. DB started, thanks! Adding a note to README recommending named volumes on mac.

infra-bot: deploy-check: local-compose -> volumes changed to named volume (pgdata). Reminder: run `docker compose down -v` to remove old bind mount.

anya (eng): Nice. If you want, I can paste our small backup script for dumping to ./backups. :thumbsup:

luis (devex): Welcome aboard — ping me for the onboarding compose template.

sam (new hire): Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
